results.title: Vietnam visa requirements for foreign tourists
results.content:
# Vietnam visa requirements

Most foreign tourists need a visa to enter Vietnam unless they come from a visa-exempt country.

## E-visa

- Available for citizens of 80+ countries.
- Single entry or multiple entry, up to 90 days.
- Apply online at the official immigration portal; processing time 3 working days.

## Visa on arrival

- Requires a pre-approved letter from a Vietnamese sponsor.
- Pay stamping fee at the airport (USD 25 single / USD 50 multi).

## Visa exemption

- Citizens of ASEAN countries, Japan, South Korea, and several European nations can stay 14-45 days without a visa.
- Check the latest list on the immigration department website before travel.

## Required documents

- Passport valid for at least 6 months beyond the entry date.
- Two recent passport photos (for visa on arrival).
- Confirmed return ticket or onward travel.

results.title: Refund and cancellation policy
results.content:
# Refund and cancellation policy

## Free cancellation

- Cancel at least 7 days before check-in: 100% refund.
- Cancel 3-6 days before check-in: 70% refund.
- Cancel within 48 hours of check-in: 50% refund.

## Non-refundable bookings

- Some promotional rates and peak-season packages are non-refundable.
- The booking confirmation email states the cancellation terms for the specific package.

## How to request a refund

1. Contact customer support with your booking ID (format BK-XXXX).
2. Provide a reason and preferred refund method (bank transfer or original payment).
3. Refunds are processed within 7-10 working days.

## Force majeure

- For natural disasters, government travel restrictions, or airline cancellations, full refunds are issued regardless of the original cancellation window.

results.title: Payment methods accepted by VietTravel
results.content:
# Payment methods

We accept the following payment methods for bookings:

## Bank transfer (Vietnam)

- Vietcombank, BIDV, Techcombank, MB Bank.
- Use the booking ID (BK-XXXX) as the transfer reference.
- Bookings are auto-confirmed within 30 minutes of receipt.

## Credit and debit cards

- Visa, Mastercard, JCB.
- 3D Secure verification required.
- Installment plans (3, 6, 12 months) available for cards issued by Vietcombank, Techcombank, and Sacombank.

## E-wallets

- MoMo, ZaloPay, ShopeePay for bookings up to 20 million VND.

## On-site payment

- Available at Saigon Sky Hotel only.
- Cash or card accepted at check-in.

results.title: Travel insurance partners
results.content:
# Travel insurance

Travel insurance is optional but strongly recommended for international tourists.

## Partners

- **PVI Insurance**: standard plan 150,000 VND/trip, premium plan 350,000 VND/trip.
- **Bao Viet Travel**: family plan covers up to 6 members, 800,000 VND.
- **Liberty Insurance**: annual multi-trip plan for frequent travellers.

## Coverage

- Medical emergencies up to 1 billion VND.
- Trip cancellation due to covered reasons.
- Lost luggage up to 50 million VND per item.

## How to buy

- Add insurance during the booking flow.
- The insurance certificate is emailed within 24 hours.

results.title: Ticketing SLA and priorities
results.excerpt:
# Ticketing policy

## Priority levels

| Priority | First response | Resolution target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| critical | 30 minutes | 4 hours |
| high | 2 hours | 1 business day |
| medium | 8 hours | 3 business days |
| low | 1 business day | 7 business days |

## When to create a ticket

- Booking or payment issue that cannot be resolved in chat.
- Refund request exceeding the auto-approval threshold (5 million VND).
- Complaints about hotel service quality.

## Sensitive data in tickets

- Never include passwords, OTPs, MFA codes, full credit card numbers.
- Mask customer phone numbers and emails before forwarding to hotels.
